simple.meaning: קְיָם (qᵉyâm) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “an edict (as arising in law).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 6:8. Its contexts include Torah, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קְיָם (H7010).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קְיָם (qᵉyâm) / H7010 is traced through Daniel 6:8, Daniel 6:16 as a generated source-based concept entry.
